target: Node 24 LTS / Linux amd64; local host Windows Node 24.19.0
prismaDecision: Prisma registry latest is an 8 RC. Keep exact stable CLI/client/adapter 7.10.0; no GA assertion.

scripts.test: npm run clean && NODE_ENV=test NODE_OPTIONS="--require tsx/cjs" vitest run
scripts.postbuild: npm run copy:collection && npm run copy:lib

scripts.pretest: npm run lint && npm run dts-check

scripts.test:pnpm: cd tests/pnpm && node check.js && pnpm install && pnpm exec tsc
scripts.test:types:all: npm run test:types && npm run test:types:5.3 && npm run test:types:5.x && npm run test:types:7.x

scripts.pretest: npm run prepare && npm run wpt:init
scripts.wpt:update: git submodule update --init --recursive --remote && cd test/web-platform-tests/tests && python wpt.py manifest --path ../wpt-manifest.json
scripts.test:to-port-to-wpts: mocha test/to-port-to-wpts/ && mocha test/to-port-to-wpts/level1/ && mocha test/to-port-to-wpts/level2/ && mocha test/to-port-to-wpts/level3/

scripts.test: npm run format:check && npm run compile && if test "$BROWSERS" = "1" ; then npm run test:browser; else npm run test:node; fi
scripts.build: rollup -c support/rollup.config.umd.js && rollup -c support/rollup.config.esm.js && rollup -c support/rollup.config.umd.msgpack.js
npm run build:compiler && npm run build:tests

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:typescript
npm run test:unit && npm run test:typescript
npm run test:unit && npm run test:typescript
npm run test:unit && npm run test:typescript
npm run test:unit && npm run test:typescript
npm run test:unit && npm run test:typescript
npm run lint && npm run unit && npm run test:types
scripts.test:ci: npm run unit && npm run test:types
scripts.test:report: npm run lint && npm run unit:report && npm run test:types
scripts.prepublishOnly: cross-env PREPUBLISH=true borp --reporter=@jsumners/line-reporter && npm run test:validator:integrity && npm run build:sync-version
scripts.test:validator:integrity: npm run build:validation && git diff --quiet --ignore-all-space --ignore-blank-lines --ignore-cr-at-eol lib/error-serializer.js && git diff --quiet --ignore-all-space --ignore-blank-lines --ignore-cr-at-eol lib/config-validator.js

scripts.test:browser: echo "Browser test is not working currently" && exit -1 && npm-run-all build:spec:browser && opn spec/support/mocha-browser-runner.html
scripts.build:package: npm-run-all build:clean compile build:global && node ./tools/prepare-package.js && node ./tools/generate-alias.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build:package && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:circular && npm run dtslint && npm run test:side-effects
scripts.build:spec:browser: echo "Browser test is not working currently" && exit -1 && webpack --config spec/support/webpack.mocha.config.js

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:modules
scripts.build:debug: npm run clean && cross-env MSAL_MINIFY_LOGS=false npm run build:modules
scripts.build:all:debug: cd ../.. && cross-env MSAL_MINIFY_LOGS=false npm run build --workspace=@azure/msal-common --workspace=@azure/msal-browser
scripts.test:coverage:only: npm run clean:coverage && npm run test:coverage

scripts.clean: premove dist-cjs dist-es dist-types tsconfig.cjs.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.es.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.types.tsbuildinfo
scripts.test:e2e: yarn g:vitest run -c vitest.config.e2e.mts && yarn test:browser

scripts.build: npm run clean:dist && npm run pretest && npm run tsc:all && npm run copy:main:type && npm run clean:temp:files && npm run copy:lua && npm run copy:includes:lua && npm run copy:sql
scripts.pretest: npm run clean:scripts && npm run generate:raw:scripts && npm run transform:commands && npm run circular:references
scripts.docs:json: mkdir -p ./apiVersions && yarn pretest && typedoc --excludeExternals --excludeProtected --excludePrivate --readme none src/index.ts --json ./apiVersions/v6.json --name v6
scripts.test:smoke: vitest run --no-file-parallelism --bail=1 tests/async_fifo_queue.test.ts tests/script_loader.test.ts tests/scripts.test.ts tests/child-pool.test.ts tests/bulk.test.ts tests/queue.test.ts

scripts.build: npm run build:rollup && npm run build:ts
scripts.test:16: mocha --ignore test/api.web_stream.js --ignore test/api.web_stream.ts --ignore test/api.stream.finished.ts --ignore test/api.stream.iterator.ts --ignore test/option.columns.js 'test/**/*.js'
scripts.build:ts: cp lib/index.d.ts dist/cjs/index.d.cts && cp lib/sync.d.ts dist/cjs/sync.d.cts && cp lib/stream.d.ts dist/cjs/stream.d.cts && cp lib/*.ts dist/esm
scripts.preversion: npm run build && git add dist

scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:tsd
npm run format:check && npm run compile && npm run test:types && npm run test:unit

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:js && pnpm run lint:ts
scripts.test: pnpm run test:js && pnpm run test:examples && pnpm run test:exports
scripts.update:examples: pnpm run build && pnpm run download:schemas && vite-node ./scripts/update-examples.ts
